package.description: A lightweight desktop widget for monitoring glucose levels through Nightscout.

en-US.description: A lightweight desktop widget for monitoring glucose levels through Nightscout.
en-US.longDescription: Owlet is a cross-platform Electron widget application that displays sensor glucose values (SGV) from a Nightscout API in real time. Intended for Type 1 Diabetes management, with trend arrows, customizable alert levels, and an always-on-top display.
en-US.name: Owlet
